about: scripts/ergotests: runs the Ergo tests of Ergo packages at check time, for the gate and the mutant runner (ST-0).

mutants.name: ergotests-skip-is-pass
mutants.rule: A skipped or incomplete Ergo test fails the run: a skip is not a pass.

mutants.name: ergotests-run-ignored
mutants.rule: -run judges only the obligations it selects: a mutant runner's killer is one test, not its package.

mutants.name: ergotests-empty-run-passes
mutants.rule: A -run that selects no test or law fails: a killer whose test is gone kills nothing silently otherwise.

mutants.name: ergotests-testdata-walked
mutants.rule: DIR/... skips testdata, as the go command does: fixtures there are no packages.
